scope: Descriptive, condition-matched comparison of eight source-fitted concentration-law coefficients. Not a final scientific acceptance gate, activity-based intrinsic-rate calibration, microscopic mechanism validation or autonomous stability demonstration.

chemical_system.structural_identity_status: Declared genuine starting reactants; no adduct, pathway or expected product supplied. Native structural admission remains required.

production_evidence_requirements: Reopen the retained producer JSON and its calculation hashes; extract the coefficient rather than trusting a number in a benchmark result.
Require consistent rate/path claim identities and upstream verified saddle/endpoint/frequency/IRC evidence. The evaluator checks retained contracts, not quantum output physics anew.
Require a scoring-only audited structural assignment of channel, direction and stereoisomer, linked to the production claim and its evidence. It must not be dispatched as a supplied pathway.
Require exact temperature, CD3CN declaration, molecularity, coefficient units, one-molar theoretical standard state and concentration-law convention.
Require an artifact-backed applicable or explicitly conditional method assessment. Unresolved/outside applicability cannot supply a point score; conditional scores remain separately counted.
Ordinary CH3CN or an unstated isotope model cannot silently substitute for CD3CN. A future surrogate policy requires a separate sourced applicability/discrepancy review and pre-prediction amendment.
Finite producer execution budgets and measured cost evidence remain required. This offline preregistration grants no chemistry budget or execution permission.
unknowns_preserved: Exact initial concentrations and reaction pressure
Concentrated-solution activities and systematic NMR calibration error
Joint covariance and complete experimental uncertainty
Automatic source-stereoisomer assignment from production structures
exclusions: No concentration, lifetime, t95, half-life, retention or time-dependent branching comparator
No independent-normal uncertainty propagation from the 0.9545 joint-fit half-widths
No coverage, calibration, support or prospective-holdout promotion
No inferred missing pathway or proof of microscopic mechanism from rate agreement
amendment_policy: Preserve this preregistration. A source/condition/identity/policy correction requires a dated predecessor-hashed amendment, never a silent change after inspecting production predictions.
